name: comp-157
title: Star Rating Filter Radio
blurb: Radio group for filtering reviews by star rating with visual star indicators.
description: Radio group with 6 options: all reviews, and 5-1 star ratings. Each option displays filled/empty stars and review count. Stars use Remix icons with opacity for empty ratings.
use_when: E-commerce review filters, rating selection, or product filtering interfaces.
avoid_when: Non-review contexts—the star rating metaphor is specific.
a11y: Each star option has sr-only 'X stars' label. Stars are aria-hidden. Count shown in sublabel. Full keyboard support.
